coverageGoal: Common household and restaurant-recognizable recipes across major cuisines, excluding highly individual chef signatures and obscure hyperlocal dishes.

channels.title: Baseline Common Recipes
channels.notes: Primary queue for common recipe identities that can become stable baseline recipes and matching targets for imports.

statuses.backlog: Known common recipe identity, not drafted yet.
statuses.drafted: Baseline recipe exists locally but needs review.
statuses.promoted: Stable baseline recipe exists in src/data/baseline-catalog.ts.
statuses.deferred: Too broad, duplicate, regional variant, or not common enough for the first coverage pass.
